verdict.rationale: Composio runs a catalog of 1000+ toolkits and hosted MCP servers, so security scanning of listed servers is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions scanning, inspecting, or vetting toolkits or servers for malicious or vulnerable behavior. Restricting a session to chosen toolkits or allowed tools is an adjacent access control, not a security review, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can rely on the platform scanning or inspecting listed servers for malicious or vulnerable behavior before my agents use them
